name: economico
description: Keep a founder-run company’s books in Economico: model contracts, record invoices and payments, reconcile receipts, and draft investor updates.

interface.longDescription: Use your agent to model your business in Economico, record customer and vendor contracts, invoices, payments and receipts, and draft investor updates from double-entry books. Requires an Economico account. Code, Stripe and email discovery use access you separately authorize in your agent. Economico records events that happened elsewhere; it does not move money, send invoices, sign agreements or file taxes.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my company’s books in Economico.
Record a vendor invoice in Economico.
Draft my monthly investor update from my Economico books.
